description: Everything the public dataset knows about one composition by its code (LC0564, lc0564, "564" are all accepted): names RU/EN, family and type, the brand's texts in the requested language (default en; ru de it fr es vi ar available), site pages in 8 languages, cover image, 3D models (3ddd/3dsky, Sketchfab), awards, whether it is certified (fact only), and the configurator status: opens with a full calculation or is calculated individually; kind (cloud of elements / ribbon / chain / on a frame / ready scene); IFC4, FBX, PDF and tender-sheet exports; whether the 1:1 ceiling drawing exists; ready links. No price, no materials, no composition dimensions — they are not published.

code.description: Catalogue code, e.g. LC0564 or LC0406-1

lang.description: Language of the texts, default en

name: get_composition
title: Composition card
